column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Date Arc
As a matter of fact, Kyousuke-shi, I've been watching you since you stepped into the shop. Who is this beautiful girl in your company?
I guess this is the first time Ayase and Saori meet...
This'll become quite troublesome if I don't do this right.
Which means it's time for a two-shot conversation.
Let me introduce you. This is Aragaki Ayase, Kirino's classmate.
P-Pleased to meet you...
Oh! If I recall, we met once on the way home from last year's 【Summer Comiket】.
Ah... You were with Kirino...
Well, it seems as if they've at least seen each other before.
Ayase, this is Saori Bajeena.
B-Bajeena?
Indeed, it is my soul name!
What "soul name"? Don't make things confusing.
Beg your pardon.
Ayase, you see, Saori Bajeena is her handle name.
Her handle name... I see.
Kyousuke-shi, that's a pretty nice comeback.
Are you an idiot?!
S-Soul name? Eh? What...?
Oh dear, I seem to have made you confused.
I apologize. Saori Bajeena is my handle name.
O-Oh. Your handle name...
No matter how you look at it, these two don't work well together.
But what am I doing exactly? I should ease things up.
Well, how about I address you as Ayase-shi?
O-Okay.
So then, why is Kyousuke-shi here with Ayase-shi?
Aha... Could it be that you're on a date?
W-Well, I guess so!
Oh! I knew it!
My, Kyousuke-shi is moving up in life!
Ahahaha! Yeah, totally!
What nonsense are you spouting? Just die!
Gah! It hurts! Are you trying to kill me?!
That's because you're lying!
Why can't you let me boast at least a little?
Besides... isn't this kind of like a date?
It is not! G-Geez, don't get so carried away...
...You're into S&M? Interesting.
Sorry, that was a lie. We're not on a date.
No, not at all. It's not like that.
Oh, is that so?
Well then, why are you two in Akiba?
You see, Ayase doesn't really like all this otaku stuff.
Okay.
O-Onii-san, you don't have to put it like that...
Just leave it to me.
Saori wouldn't get angry over such petty matters.
She doesn't like otaku stuff, but she's best friends with Kirino.
Yes, okay.
So she was thinking she'd try understanding Kirino's hobby, even if just a little.
So it's like that.
You're a very nice person, Ayase-shi.
